submission.justification: Algorithm-L2 gave the highest simulated signal efficiency at the allocated rate. At 35 GeV it reached 91.9%, against 85.3% for L1 and 73.2% for L3. For L2 I scanned 25, 30, 35 and 40 GeV, and 30 GeV was best at 92.1%. The 30 and 35 GeV results differ by only 0.26 points, so they may not be statistically distinguishable. I did not scan L1 or L3 away from 35 GeV. Latency was not documented, so I could not check it.

requirements.evidence: The specs say all candidates fit the FPGA resource budget (LUTs, DSPs), and the links document says link bandwidth is sufficient. No document gives a latency budget or L2 latency, so I could not verify that the iterative clustering meets Level-1 latency.

requirements.requirement: Highest signal efficiency at the allocated 8 kHz rate
requirements.evidence: Simulated efficiency for L2 at 30 GeV was 92.1%. At 35 GeV the three algorithms scored L2 91.9%, L1 85.3% and L3 73.2%. This matches the 2025 summary.
